data.name: Flutter
content: Flutter is my {{primary}} development framework for building {{high-quality}} cross-platform mobile applications.
I use Flutter to build {{scalable}}, {{maintainable}}, and {{production-ready}} apps for both {{iOS}} and {{Android}} from a single codebase.
I have extensive experience with {{Bloc}} and {{Riverpod}} for state management, focusing on {{clean architecture}} and long-term maintainability.
I've led Flutter projects from {{architecture}} to {{App Store / Play Store}} deployment and ongoing iteration.
If Flutter were a tool, it would be my {{daily driver}}.

data.name: React Native
content: React Native allows me to build {{cross-platform}} mobile applications using {{JavaScript}} and {{TypeScript}}.
I've used it in production apps that integrate with {{REST APIs}}, {{GraphQL}}, and native device features.
My experience with React Native complements my Flutter background and helps me adapt quickly to different stacks.
If Flutter is my strength, React Native is my {{reliable alternative}}.

data.name: Frontend Development
content: My frontend experience spans {{mobile}} and {{web}} platforms with a strong focus on {{UX}}, {{performance}}, and {{maintainability}}.
I've built interfaces using {{React}}, {{Next.js}}, and modern frontend tooling.
I value {{clean UI architecture}}, predictable state, and close collaboration with designers and product teams.

data.name: Backend Development
content: I've built and maintained backends using {{Node.js}}, {{Express}}, {{Spring Boot}}, and {{Laravel}}.
My backend work includes {{REST APIs}}, {{GraphQL}}, {{authentication}}, and {{database design}}.
I focus on writing {{clean}}, {{secure}}, and {{scalable}} backend systems that support real production traffic.

data.name: Databases
content: I've worked with {{PostgreSQL}}, {{MySQL}}, and other {{SQL-based}} databases in production environments.
I'm comfortable designing {{schemas}}, writing {{optimized queries}}, and integrating databases into backend services.
I value correctness, data integrity, and long-term maintainability.

data.name: Cloud & Infrastructure
content: I have hands-on experience deploying and maintaining systems on {{AWS}}, {{GCP}}, and {{Azure}}.
My experience includes {{cloud hosting}}, {{environment configuration}}, {{CI/CD}}, and {{infrastructure ownership}}.
I've taken responsibility for frontend infrastructure and cloud setup in startup environments.

data.name: Docker
content: Docker is a core part of my workflow for {{local development}}, {{testing}}, and {{deployment}}.
I use Docker to ensure {{consistent environments}} across teams and stages.
It helps me move faster while reducing environment-related issues.

data.name: Git
content: Git is my primary tool for {{version control}} and {{team collaboration}}.
I've worked with {{feature branching}}, {{code reviews}}, and {{remote-first}} teams.
Clear commits and good collaboration practices matter to me.

data.name: C / C++ / Arduino
content: I have experience with {{C}}, {{C++}}, and {{Arduino}} for {{low-level}} and {{embedded}} programming.
This background helps me better understand {{performance}}, {{memory}}, and how software interacts with hardware.
While not my primary focus today, it strongly shapes how I think as an engineer.

data.name: Software Architecture
content: I care deeply about {{architecture}}, {{code quality}}, and {{long-term maintainability}}.
I've designed systems using {{clean architecture}}, {{modular design}}, and well-defined boundaries.
Good architecture enables teams to move fast without breaking things.
